card.name: Quantity and amount words in how-to text
card.fires_on: Words that set up an amount or degree in general explanatory text, such as largest, small, equal, vary, varies. Mostly in web text on water, cooking, or practical processes.

modes.label: Amount modifiers
modes.description: Size or amount words just before a noun like spectrum, amount, or parts.
modes.example: The most effective method for remoiving the<< largest>> spectrum of contaminants is Reverse Osmosis
